messages:
alex: Quick flag from today's backup audit - found 4 DB snapshot objects in gs://redwood-backups/legacy/ (2018-2020) that lack our x-encrypt-meta header and show no kmsKeyName.

tara: Paths? sample metadata?

alex: samples:
- legacy/db-prod-2018-07-12.sql.gz
- legacy/db-prod-2019-02-21-part2.dump
I ran `gsutil ls -L gs://redwood-backups/legacy/db-prod-2018-07-12.sql.gz` -> only Content-Type and CRC32C present, no encryption fields.

noah: Timeline looks pre-CMEK rollout. Which SA uploaded them?

alex: Insert logs show `backup-agent-legacy@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` between 2018-2019.

encops-bot: ALERT: missing_encryption_meta detected (count=4) in redwood-backups/legacy. Recommend audit-insert-events, access-log-scan, small-scale rewrite test.

sre-oncall: First triage: scan access logs for any GETs to those keys between 2018-2021. If public reads -> escalate to #incidents.

tara: Cloud Logging query to run:
```
resource.type="gcs_bucket"
resource.labels.bucket_name="redwood-backups"
protoPayload.methodName="storage.objects.insert"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"backup-agent-legacy@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
timestamp>="2018-01-01T00:00:00Z" AND timestamp<"2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"
```

noah: Also grep `SetIamPolicy` events around that period to see if any broad write perms were accidentally granted.

alex: I ran access logs quick-scan -> no public GETs, only internal SAs and `vendor-uploader@partner.example.com` entries.

encops-bot: REMINDER: when creating KMS grants for re-encrypt/rewrite, record grant IDs and TTLs in the escrow manifest.

tara: Remediation plan: 1) block legacy agent write perms via infra PR, 2) test `gsutil rewrite -k` on 2 objects to add kmsKeyName and verify restore, 3) produce escrow manifest (object path + original insert event ID + uploader principal) and store in restricted CMEK-protected bucket.

sre-oncall: Keep Legal in the loop. If no external reads, treat as compliance remediation.

legal: Acknowledge. We'll prepare a customer-safe template but won't send unless security flags customer-impacting restores.

alex: Test rewrite succeeded on 2 objects; metadata now shows kmsKeyName and restore to staging DB worked end-to-end. No errors.

noah: I'll open ENCRYPT-OPS ticket and assign P2, include Cloud Logging queries, object list, and rewrite command. Also add a nightly scanner that alerts on objects missing x-encrypt-meta.

tara: Also add an IaC pre-merge check to require `encryption_review=true` for any PR that adds storage.objectAdmin bindings.

sre-oncall: Thanks. If we discover any unexpected external reads escalate to #incidents immediately. Otherwise continue with re-encrypt and RBAC hardening. :lock:
